newsitem.title: GERMANY: Toepfer leaves 97 EU rape crop estimate at 7.7 M T.
newsitem.headline: Toepfer leaves 97 EU rape crop estimate at 7.7 M T.

text.p: The European Union rapeseed crop in 1997 is forecast at 7.7 million tonnes after 7.3 million in 1996, German grain trader Alfred C Toepfer said in its latest monthly newsletter.
It put the likely EU sunseed crop in 1997 at 3.8 million tonnes, down from 4.1 million last year.
The feed peas crop could total four million tonnes after 3.6 million in 1996 because the area had been expanded by 10 percent to just over one million hectares, Toepfer also said.
Toepfer said already in its April report the 1997 rapeseed crop should be 7.7 million tonnes but at that stage, the trader still pegged EU 1997 sunseed output at four million tonnes.
Toepfer in its latest comments on grain crop progress pointed to dry conditions in Mediterranean countries.

Toepfer's rapeseed area estimate for 1997 is broadly in line with the one published by EU oilseeds lobby ANGO, at 2.7 million ha, which is up two percent from last year. -Vera Eckert, Hamburg newsroom, +49-40-41903275
